title: trailing slash in WebDAV URL not stripped or rejected
description: WebDavBackendConfig.url says 'must end without a trailing slash' in doc comment, but nothing enforces this. With url = 'https://dav.example.com/stoa/blocks/', block_path produces '//bafyrei...' which some WebDAV servers accept and some reject (non-RFC behaviour). Fix: either strip trailing slash at config-validation time (return Err) or rtrim it in the WebDavStore constructor before building the HttpBuilder.
